text: Spirals, snakes and diagonals over grids of width 2 to 48, read forwards or backwards: 1,128 ways of shuffling the 97 letters before the sculpture's table.
Drawn for one route, a clockwise spiral on rows of 10. Each known letter moves to a new place; the carved letter there must be its enciphered form.

No route lets a secret word shorter than 23 letters explain the known letters, and the best forced key run, GLEBRIM at -4.937, is no more English than on shuffled coppers. After a letter swap instead of the table, no route passes at all.
